facts.fact: 主街上的 Good Vintage 是 Sean（他妈妈）的古董店——她上街前差点把 Sean 这个人忘了。
facts.anchor: The traffic slows to five miles an hour when a sign displaying Good Vintage in bright lilac lettering makes all the blood in my body drain. It’s the antique shop—Sean’s antique shop.

facts.fact: 心理医生的归因：吸毒的生母 + 极少给她温情的继母，造就她「永远不够好」的执念。
facts.anchor: My therapist would tell me I cared so much back then because it stemmed from my childhood issues of never feeling good enough. Having a drug addict for a mother and a stepmother who showed very little affection toward me would be the source.

facts.fact: 店里一幅现代帆布画印着《哥林多前书》16:14 经句，Billie 心里说「我喜欢这句」。
facts.anchor: Let all that you do, be done in love - 1 Corinthians 16:14

facts.fact: 两人上一次在一起是九年前：在她车里告别，Sean 当时说永远不会放弃他们。
facts.anchor: It’s been nine years since we were together last. Since we said goodbye in my car. The moment he told me he’d never give up on us.

facts.fact: Sean 留在 Lakewood 的原因：妈妈做不动那么多小时，他替她把店撑下去。
facts.anchor: “Yeah, my mom couldn’t do as many hours anymore, but she loves this place, so I keep it going for her.”

facts.fact: 她鼓起勇气约明早九点咖啡，他先假装犹豫再逗她——她窘到满脸通红。
facts.anchor: “I’m just messing with you.” His hair falls over his eyes as he chuckles at me.

facts.fact: 新兵训练营期间 Sean 每月写信、共八封，且越来越严肃、越来越少浪漫。
facts.anchor: He’d sent eight letters total, and each letter became more serious and less romantic.

facts.fact: 信停止的真正原因：Billie 从来没有回过信——她自认当年自私、残忍。
facts.anchor: I know why he stopped sending them. It’s because I never wrote back.

facts.fact: 明早咖啡的目的：弥补那些「为保护自己的心而弄碎他的心」的时刻。
facts.anchor: That’s what I’m hoping to fix with Sean tomorrow. Possibly make up for all those times I broke his heart to protect mine.
